product_overview: Smash POS is a web-based POS/ERP for fast-casual restaurants that combines branch access, cashier operations, inventory control, recipes, production, MRP planning, and sales reporting in one Spanish-language application. It is designed to help each branch manage orders, cash, stock, and operational decisions from a single system.
core_goals: Register a branch and onboard its first administrator
Let staff access the system by branch login, employee selection, and PIN
Open, manage, and close cash register shifts
Take orders, send them to kitchen, and charge customers using multiple payment methods
Manage employees, products, recipes, inventory, and stock movements by branch
Run production batches and MRP planning for replenishment
Review sales performance and export sales reports for analysis

features.name: Branch registration and first administrator
features.description: Public onboarding flow that creates a new branch and then sets up the first administrator account for that branch.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Enter the branch name, address, email, phone, and password -> Submit the registration form -> See the first administrator setup step -> Navigate to /signup/newadmin with the branch identifier -> Enter the administrator's full name, username, email, phone, password, and password confirmation -> Submit the administrator form -> See the access screen at /

features.name: Branch login, employee selection, and PIN access
features.description: Two-step access flow where the branch logs in first, then the employee is selected and validated with a PIN before role-based routing.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter the branch email -> Enter the branch password -> Submit the login form -> See the employee selection screen at /usuarios -> Select an active employee -> See the PIN entry screen -> Enter the employee PIN -> Submit the PIN -> See the administrator dashboard at /admin or the cashier area at /cajero
Navigate to / -> Enter the branch email -> Enter the wrong password -> Submit the login form -> See an inline credential error

features.name: Role-based access and logout
features.description: Controls access to protected areas based on branch and employee session state, and lets the logged-in employee end their session.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin while logged in as a cashier -> See redirect to /cajero
Navigate to /cajero while logged in as an administrator -> Continue into the cashier area
Open the user menu -> Choose to log out -> See the employee selection screen at /usuarios
Try to visit /admin, /cajero, or /usuarios without a valid session -> See redirect to /

features.name: Cash register opening
features.description: Lets a cashier or administrator count the opening cash by denomination to start a shift, or continue directly if a register is already open.
user_flows: Navigate to /cajero -> Review the opening cash summary -> Enter bill and coin counts by denomination -> Submit the opening -> See the POS screen at /cajero/ventas

features.name: POS order taking and comanda sending
features.description: Lets the cashier build an order from the product catalog, personalize items, set the customer name, and send the order to kitchen and payment.
user_flows: Navigate to /cajero/ventas -> Select a product from the catalog -> Open item customization -> Add extras and notes -> Enter the customer name -> Submit the order -> See the kitchen ticket open and be taken to /cajero/metodos-pago
Navigate to /cajero/ventas -> Select products for the cart -> Remove an item from the cart -> Cancel the order -> See the cart clear
Navigate to /cajero/ventas -> Open open orders -> Return to the sales screen -> Continue editing an order using its edit link

features.name: Open orders management
features.description: Shows unpaid orders for the current shift and allows reprint, edit, void, or charging actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /cajero/pedidos -> Review the list of open orders -> Print a ticket for one order -> See the kitchen ticket page open
Navigate to /cajero/pedidos -> Choose an open order to edit -> See /cajero/ventas with the order loaded
Navigate to /cajero/pedidos -> Choose an open order to void -> Confirm the void -> See the order removed from the open list
Navigate to /cajero/pedidos -> Choose an open order to charge -> See /cajero/metodos-pago for that order

features.name: Payment and billing
features.description: Allows the cashier to collect payment for an order using cash or non-cash methods and capture billing details before completing the charge.
user_flows: Navigate to /cajero/metodos-pago -> Select Efectivo as the payment method -> Enter the received amount -> Review the change due -> Enter billing details if needed -> Confirm the charge -> See the order completed
Navigate to /cajero/metodos-pago -> Select Tarjeta Crédito/Débito as the payment method -> Enter the first four digits -> Enter the last four digits -> Confirm the charge -> See the order completed
Navigate to /cajero/metodos-pago -> Select Pago QR or Transferencia as the payment method -> Enter NIT / CI and Razón Social if needed -> Confirm the charge -> See the order completed
Navigate to /cajero/metodos-pago -> Choose to void the order -> Confirm the void -> See the order cancelled

features.name: Cash movements during shift
features.description: Lets the cashier record manual cash entries or withdrawals and review the shift movement totals.
user_flows: Navigate to /cajero/ventas -> Open the cash movement panel -> Choose Entrada or Salida -> Enter the amount and reason -> Submit the movement -> See the movement totals update

features.name: Cash register closing
features.description: Lets the cashier declare counted amounts, compare them against the expected totals, add notes, and close the shift with a closing ticket.
user_flows: Navigate to /cajero/cierre -> Enter declared amounts for the payment methods and denominations -> Add an optional note about any difference -> Review the expected, declared, and difference summary -> Close the register -> See the closing ticket and session logout

features.name: Admin dashboard
features.description: Provides period-based operational metrics for the branch, including sales, costs, top products, stock alerts, and a statistics chart.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Switch the period between Mes and Semana -> Review the updated metrics, top products, stock alerts, and chart

features.name: Sales audit and voiding
features.description: Lets the administrator browse sales, inspect sale details, and void a sale with a reason.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/ventas -> Filter or browse the sales list -> Open a sale detail view -> Review the sale information
Navigate to /admin/ventas -> Open the void sale flow for a sale -> Enter the reason -> Confirm the void -> See the sale marked as voided

features.name: Sales report CSV export
features.description: Allows the administrator to generate downloadable CSV sales reports for different breakdowns over a chosen date range.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/reporte-ventas -> Choose a date range -> Choose a report type -> Download the CSV report

features.name: Employee management
features.description: Lets the administrator review employees, create new employees, edit employee details, and change active status.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/usuarios -> Open the new employee form -> Enter the employee information and credentials -> Submit the form -> See the employee added to the list
Navigate to /admin/usuarios -> Open an employee card for editing -> Update the employee information -> Toggle the active status -> Save the changes -> See the list reflect the update

features.name: Inventory management
features.description: Provides inventory operations for the branch, including purchase entries, mermas, kardex review, item management, stock control, bulk upload, and alerts.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/inventario -> Open the entry form -> Select an item -> Enter quantity, cost, supplier, and movement reason -> Save the entry -> See the new inventory movement recorded
Navigate to /admin/inventario -> Open the waste form -> Enter the merma details -> Save the waste record -> See the inventory update
Navigate to /admin/inventario -> Open the kardex view -> Filter movements -> Review entries and adjustments -> Edit or void a movement when needed
Navigate to /admin/inventario -> Open the item list or item editor -> Add or update item details -> Save the changes -> See the updated catalog
Navigate to /admin/inventario -> Open the bulk upload flow -> Download the CSV template -> Fill the file -> Upload the CSV -> See the imported items reflected in the inventory
Navigate to /admin/inventario -> Open stock alerts -> Review items with low stock -> Choose to replenish one item -> Open the entry form preselected for that item

features.name: Production batches
features.description: Lets the administrator produce prepared items by selecting a preparation, entering quantity, checking ingredient availability, and confirming the batch.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/produccion -> Select a preparation -> Enter the quantity to produce -> Review ingredient availability and estimated cost -> Confirm the production -> See the batch added to recent productions

features.name: MRP planning
features.description: Lets the administrator configure and run material requirements planning, then review past runs and their details.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/mrp -> Configure the run parameters -> Execute the planning run -> Review the forecast, master production schedule, and material explosion results
Navigate to /admin/mrp -> Open a past planning run -> Review the run details

features.name: Recipes and extras editor
features.description: Lets the administrator search recipes, filter recipe types, review theoretical cost, and edit ingredients or extras.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/recetas -> Search for a recipe by name or SKU -> Change the sort order or filter by recipe type -> Review the matching recipes
Navigate to /admin/recetas -> Open a recipe card for editing -> Update ingredients or extras -> Save the changes -> See the recipe updated

features.name: Menu editor
features.description: Lets the administrator search, filter, and edit the product menu by status and category.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/menu -> Search by name or category -> Filter by status or category -> Clear filters if needed -> Open a product card for editing -> Save the changes -> See the product list updated

tech_stack: Next.js 15 (App Router, middleware.ts route protection, route groups)
jose + jsonwebtoken (JWT in httpOnly cookies tokenSucursal and tokenEmpleado), bcrypt (password and PIN hashes)
ApexCharts (react-apexcharts), FullCalendar, lucide-react icons, sonner toasts, react-dnd, react-flatpickr
Playwright (e2e and smoke tests, port 3100, separate _test database), tsx test runner

routes.description: Branch (sucursal) login form with Correo and Contraseña fields and Iniciar Sesión button; success goes to /usuarios.
Public branch registration form (nombre, dirección, correo, teléfono, contraseña); success redirects to /signup/newadmin?sucursalId=<id>.
Creates the first Administrador employee for a newly registered branch (reads sucursalId from the query string); success goes to /.
Employee selection ("¿Quién eres?") grid listing active employees of the logged-in branch; needs only tokenSucursal. Visiting it purges any tokenEmpleado.
PIN entry for the chosen employee (?id=<empleadoId>); redirects to /admin for Administrador or /cajero for Cajero. Matches the /usuarios middleware prefix so it needs tokenSucursal.
Explicit 404 page from the template (unknown URLs render src/app/not-found.tsx with the same look).
Administrador dashboard with Mes/Semana period selector, sales/cost/top-product widgets, stock alerts and a statistics chart.
Sales audit list with detail modal and administrative void (anular) modal. Administrador only.
Employee management list with edit cards, activate/deactivate switch and a modal to create a new employee. Administrador only.
Inventory hub with buttons that open modals for entradas, mermas, kardex, control de stock, item list, new item, bulk CSV upload and alerts. Administrador only.
Production batches form (pick preparación, quantity, ingredient availability table) plus recent productions table; uses the executeProductionBatch server action. Administrador only.
Material requirements planning panel (demand forecast, MPS, material explosion, run history). Administrador only.
Recipe (ficha técnica) browser with filters Todos/Vendibles/Preparaciones, search, sort, and recipe and extras editor cards. Administrador only.
Product menu editor with search, estado and categoría chips, and per-product edit cards. Administrador only.
Sales report downloads in CSV (por usuario, caja, producto, anuladas) with date range. Administrador only.
Empty placeholder page (renders an empty grid); not linked from the sidebar. Administrador only.
Cash register opening (Apertura de Caja) with denomination count; redirects to /cajero/ventas when the register is already open, to /usuarios on session errors. Cajero or Administrador.
POS screen with product catalog grid, personalize drawer, cart panel (Comandar), client name field, Pedidos abiertos and Movimiento de caja buttons. Supports ?editId=<pedidoId> to edit an open order.
List of open orders with Imprimir, Editar, Anular and Cobrar actions per order.
Payment screen (?id=&total=&cliente=) with Efectivo/Tarjeta/Pago QR/Transferencia, NIT/CI and Razón Social, cash change calculator, card digits, confirm and anular.
Cierre de Caja with declared denomination counts, expected vs declared vs difference summary, notes, closing ticket, and employee logout after closing.
Printable kitchen order ticket (Comanda / Orden de Preparación) for a pedido, opened in a new tab after Comandar; has a print button.

features.name: Branch (sucursal) login
features.description: Step 1 of the two-step auth. The branch logs in with correo and contraseña; the server sets the httpOnly tokenSucursal cookie (12h JWT) and clears tokenEmpleado. Rate limited (15 req/min per IP, 5 failures lock the email for 15 min).
user_interactions: LOGIN SEQUENCE step 1: open / and type the branch email smoke@smash.test in the Correo field (type=email).
LOGIN SEQUENCE step 1: type the branch password SmokeTest2026! in the Contraseña field (eye icon toggles visibility).
Click the Iniciar Sesión button; on success a toast "Operación exitosa" shows and the app navigates to /usuarios.
LOGIN SEQUENCE step 2: on /usuarios click the card of the employee (admin_smoke for Administrador, cajero_smoke for Cajero).
LOGIN SEQUENCE step 3: on /usuarios/pin type PIN 1234 in the password input (aria-label PIN) and click Ingresar; admin_smoke lands on /admin, cajero_smoke lands on /cajero then /cajero/ventas.
Submit a wrong password to see an error message under the form (default "Credenciales inválidas").
Click the link to /signup below the form to register a new branch.

features.name: Employee selection (kiosk)
features.description: After branch login the user picks who is operating the terminal. Lists only active employees of the branch (usuario and rol), requires tokenSucursal only.
user_interactions: Click an employee card (admin_smoke or cajero_smoke) to go to /usuarios/pin?id=<id>.
Click the retry button if loading employees fails (reloads the page).

features.name: Employee PIN login and role routing
features.description: Step 3 of auth. Verifies the PIN (stored as bcrypt hash in empleados.contrasena) and sets the tokenEmpleado cookie. The response rol drives the redirect through rutaPorRol (Administrador to /admin, Cajero to /cajero; any other role shows an error). PIN attempts are rate limited per branch and IP.
user_interactions: Type the PIN (1234 for both admin_smoke and cajero_smoke in the smoke seed) into the PIN input; Ingresar is disabled while empty.
Click "Elige otro usuario" to go back to /usuarios.
A wrong PIN shows an inline role=alert error (default text "PIN incorrecto").
Opening /usuarios/pin without a valid ?id redirects back to /usuarios.

features.name: Role-based access control and logout
features.description: middleware.ts protects /admin, /cajero and /usuarios. No tokenSucursal redirects to /. /admin and /cajero without a valid tokenEmpleado redirect to /usuarios. tokenEmpleado sucursalId must match tokenSucursal. /admin is Administrador only (a Cajero is redirected to /cajero); /cajero accepts both roles. API routes re-check with requireEmpleado and the DB row (estado/rol).
user_interactions: As cajero_smoke navigate to /admin and observe redirect to /cajero.
As admin_smoke use the sidebar link "Abrir Caja" to operate the register at /cajero.
Open the header user dropdown and click "Cerrar sesión" to log out the employee (scope=empleado) and return to /usuarios.
Unauthenticated visit to /admin, /cajero or /usuarios redirects to /.

features.name: Branch registration and first administrator
features.description: Public onboarding. Registers a new sucursal, then creates its first Administrador employee (rol forced to Administrador when no admin session exists).
user_interactions: Fill Nombre de la sucursal, Dirección, Correo, Teléfono and Contraseña on /signup and submit; redirects to /signup/newadmin?sucursalId=<id>.
Fill Nombre completo, Nombre de usuario, correo, Número de celular, Contraseña and Confirma tu contraseña on /signup/newadmin and submit; redirects to /.

features.name: Cash register opening
features.description: Cajero or Administrador counts opening cash by denomination to open a shift (apertura). Skips straight to /cajero/ventas if a register is already open.
user_interactions: Enter bill and coin quantities in the Arqueo de Caja denomination form.
Click Confirmar Apertura; on success navigates to /cajero/ventas.

features.name: POS order taking (Comandar)
features.description: Main cashier screen. Select products from the catalog, customize with extras and notes, set the client name, and send the order. Creates the pedido, opens the comanda ticket in a new tab and goes to payment. Order is always saved with mesa "Mesa 1". Items without stock are dropped with an alert.
user_interactions: Click the product card "Hamburguesa Smoke" (price 50) to add it to Pedido Actual.
Open the personalize drawer on a product to add extras (modificadores) and notes.
Type a name in the Cliente field (default "Cliente Mostrador").
Click Comandar (becomes Actualizar Pedido when editing); a new tab opens with the comanda and the app goes to /cajero/metodos-pago.
Click "Cancelar pedido" and accept the confirm() dialog to clear the cart; use the remove button on a cart line to delete an item.
Click Pedidos abiertos to go to /cajero/pedidos, Movimiento de caja to open the modal, Cerrar caja to go to /cajero/cierre.

features.name: Open orders management
features.description: Lists open (unpaid) orders for the shift with reprint, edit, void and charge actions.
user_interactions: Click Imprimir to open the comanda ticket (/cajero/comanda/[id]).
Click Editar to open /cajero/ventas?editId=<id>.
Click Anular to void an order.
Click Cobrar to go to /cajero/metodos-pago for that order.
Use the new order button to return to /cajero/ventas and the refresh button to reload the list.

features.name: Payment and billing
features.description: Charges an order with Efectivo (cash with change calculation), Tarjeta Crédito/Débito (first and last 4 digits), Pago QR or Transferencia, with optional NIT/CI and Razón Social, and registers the invoice (facturación). Can also void the order.
user_interactions: Select a payment method tile (Efectivo, Tarjeta Crédito/Débito, Pago QR, Transferencia).
For Efectivo type the received amount and see Cambio / Vuelto.
For Tarjeta fill the Primeros 4 and Últimos 4 digit fields.
Fill NIT / CI (placeholder 0000000) and Razón Social (placeholder Nombre Cliente).
Click the confirm button to charge; click Anular to void the order; use the back control to return to /cajero/ventas.

features.name: Cash movements (entradas and salidas)
features.description: Modal available from the cashier top bar to register cash in or out of the register with a reason, and view the shift's movements and totals.
user_interactions: Click Movimiento de caja in the top bar to open the modal.
Toggle the tipo de movimiento (Entrada or Salida), enter Monto (0.00) and Razón (e.g. Pago a proveedor) and submit.
Review the Movimientos del turno section with Entradas and Salidas totals.

features.name: Cash register closing (cierre de caja)
features.description: Declares counted cash and other methods by denomination, compares with expected totals, adds an optional note, closes the shift, shows a printable closing ticket and logs the employee out.
user_interactions: Enter declared amounts (0.00 inputs) per payment method and denominations.
Type an optional explanation for sobrante or faltante in the notes textarea.
Review the Resumen del cierre block (Esperado, Declarado, Diferencia, Total esperado, Total declarado, Diferencia total).
Click the close button (cerrarCaja); if no register is open an "Ir a Ventas" button is shown instead.

features.name: Admin dashboard
features.description: Period-based (Mes or Semana) KPIs with monthly sales, production cost target, top products, stock alerts card and statistics chart.
user_interactions: Switch the period selector between Mes and Semana and watch widgets refresh.
Read top products, stock alerts and the statistics chart.
Use the sidebar to navigate to other admin sections.

features.name: Sales audit and administrative void
features.description: Administrador reviews sales (comprobantes, FEFO costing) with detail modal and can void a sale with a reason via AnularVentaModal.
user_interactions: Filter and browse the sales table.
Open a sale to see VentaDetalleModal.
Open AnularVentaModal on a sale, enter the reason and confirm the void.

features.name: Sales report CSV export
features.description: Administrador downloads sales reports as CSV (by user, by register, by product, voided sales) over a date range.
user_interactions: Choose a date range and report type.
Click the download button to fetch a CSV file.

features.name: Employee management
features.description: Administrador lists employees, edits profile data and active status, and creates new employees (Cajero or Administrador) with a PIN/password stored hashed.
user_interactions: Click the add-user button to open the new user Modal.
Fill Nombre Completo, Nombre de Usuario, Correo Electrónico, Celular, Contraseña and Confirmar Contraseña and submit.
Edit an employee from its UserMetaCard and toggle the active Switch.
Click the retry button when loading fails.

features.name: Inventory management (modals)
features.description: Inventory hub for the branch. Register purchase entries with cost, record mermas, browse kardex (with entry editing/voiding), manage items, set standard cost, bulk CSV import with template, stock control and alerts, add suppliers.
user_interactions: Click the primary add button to open EntradaModal (select item, quantity, motivo Compra/Ajuste positivo/Transferencia, cost total or unitario, proveedor) and save.
Click the Mermas button to record waste.
Click the Kardex button to browse movements by filters, edit or void an entry.
Click Control de stock, lista de items, nuevo item, carga masiva (download plantilla CSV and upload CSV) and alertas buttons to open their modals.
Use Reponer from the stock alerts card to open EntradaModal preselected.

features.name: Production batches
features.description: Administrador produces a preparación from its recipe, checking ingredient availability and estimated cost, consuming insumo stock and creating a new lot; lists recent productions. Uses a Next.js server action (no REST endpoint).
user_interactions: Select a Preparación in the select (placeholder "Seleccione una preparación").
Type Cantidad (e.g. 10) and review the table Insumo/Requerido/Disponible/Costo est./Estado with Suficiente badges.
Confirm the production and read the Producciones recientes table (Fecha, Preparación, Cantidad, Costo unit., Lote, Vence).

features.name: MRP planning
features.description: Runs demand forecast, master production schedule and material explosion, and shows past runs.
user_interactions: Configure the run parameters in the panel and execute the MRP.
Open a past corrida to see its detail.

features.name: Recipes and extras editor
features.description: Administrador browses all recipes (vendibles and preparaciones), sees theoretical cost, and edits ingredient lists and extras (modificadores).
user_interactions: Click Actualizar to reload; click the filter cards Total Fichas Técnicas, Productos Vendibles, Preparaciones Base.
Type in "Buscar receta por nombre o SKU" and change the sort (Nombre A a Z, Z a A, SKU).
Edit ingredients (item and cantidad) or extras on a recipe card and save.

features.name: Menu (product) editor
features.description: Administrador searches and filters the product menu by estado and categoría and edits each product through ProductosCard.
user_interactions: Type in "Buscar por nombre o categoría".
Click estado filter chips and categoría chips; click the clear-filters button.
Edit a product on its card and save.

known_limitations.issue: Admin sidebar "Gastos" link points to a route that does not exist (404 via not-found.tsx).
known_limitations.impact: Clicking Gastos in the sidebar shows the 404 page; no expenses feature exists.

known_limitations.issue: Sidebar Reportes submenu has four dead links (Gastos, Inventario, Compras, Cajas) with no page under src/app.
known_limitations.impact: Only Reportes > Ventas works; the other four entries lead to the 404 page.

known_limitations.issue: /admin/reportes renders an empty grid with no content and is not linked in the sidebar.
known_limitations.impact: Placeholder page with nothing to test.

known_limitations.issue: Template leftovers. UserInfoCard and UserAddressCard are unused and only console.log on save; auth/error pages keep "TailAdmin" template metadata titles.
known_limitations.impact: Dead code; only wrong page titles are user-visible.

known_limitations.issue: Orders are always saved with mesa "Mesa 1"; there is no table selector in the UI.
known_limitations.impact: Mesa cannot be chosen; every comanda prints Mesa 1.

known_limitations.issue: Several flows use blocking window alert()/confirm() dialogs instead of toasts (open-register failure, order errors, out-of-stock notice, recipe save, new/edit item, item cost, entrada validation).
known_limitations.impact: Automated browser tests must handle native dialogs; the messages are not DOM elements.

known_limitations.issue: Comandar opens a blank popup window (window.open about:blank) for the comanda ticket before the request completes.
known_limitations.impact: Popup blockers or test runners may close or ignore the new tab; the ticket lives at /cajero/comanda/[id].

known_limitations.issue: Stale TODO comment says to replace with the real API call although registrarEntrada is already called; recetasCard leaves console.log of payloads.
known_limitations.impact: Misleading comment and debug logging only.

known_limitations.issue: Login and PIN endpoints are rate limited in memory (15 requests/min per IP, 5 failed logins lock an email for 15 minutes, PIN spray limit 30 per 5 minutes).
known_limitations.impact: Repeated failed or rapid logins in tests can lock out smoke@smash.test or return 429.
Navigating to /usuarios during a test logs the employee out; the PIN step must be repeated.
